episode.title: The Decision
intro: Emma tells Ren she cares, but she will not start a relationship. She wants only professional contact. That night, she writes Leo a letter. She admits the hidden dinner and the false message. She does not ask for forgiveness. Claire will pass it on only after checking Leo wants it.
エマはレンに、気持ちはあるが交際は始めないと言います。連絡は仕事だけにします。その夜、レオに手紙を書きます。隠した夕食とうそを認めます。許しは求めません。クレアは、レオが受け取りたいか確認してから渡します。
goal: I can read a decision and an apology without mistaking them for a request.
決意と謝罪を読み、依頼と間違えずに理解できる。
episode.warmup: What words show a clear decision in a message?
words: 決めました（決意しました）。
I intend to keep things professional.
I take responsibility for what I did.
責任を取ります／責任を持ちます。
I am not asking for forgiveness.
There is no need to reply.
Please ask before passing it on.
discussion: You are Emma. Your tutor is Claire. Explain why you wrote the letter. Ask Claire to check if Leo wants to receive it.
あなたはエマ役、講師はクレア役です。なぜ手紙を書いたか説明し、レオが受け取りたいか確認してもらいましょう。
episode.followup: How can you say clearly that the reader does not need to reply?

rule: Use clear intention words: “I intend to …” or “I will not …”. Feelings are not the same as agreement.
意思は「I intend to ...」「I will not ...」で明確にします。気持ちと同意は別です。
examples: I care about you, but I will not start a relationship.
あなたを大切に思っていますが、交際は始めません。

rule: In an apology, look for: the action, responsibility, and next step. If it says “no reply,” do not add a demand.
謝罪では、行動・責任・次の対応を見ます。「返事不要」なら要求を足しません。
examples: You do not need to reply. I will respect your decision.
返事は不要です。あなたの決めたことを尊重します。

situation: Read Emma’s note to Ren and her letter to Leo. Find her intentions in each.
エマのレンへのメモと、レオへの手紙を読みます。それぞれの意思を確認しましょう。
apply.text:
Emma to Ren
I care about you, but I will not start a relationship. I intend to keep our contact professional. Please use the team channel and discuss project decisions at work.

Emma’s letter to Leo
I hid Friday’s dinner and told you I was working. That was my choice, and it hurt you. I should have been honest. I am sorry. I am not asking you to forgive me or continue our relationship. You do not need to reply. I will respect your decision.
questions: What does Emma decide about Ren?
She will not start a relationship and will keep contact professional.
What actions does she name in the letter?
She hid the dinner and said she was working.
Does she ask Leo to forgive her or continue the relationship?
No, she says there is no need to reply.

choose: I intend (to keep / keeping) contact professional.
I am not asking (for / to) forgiveness.
There is no need (to reply / replying).
I take responsibility for what I (did / done).
Please ask before (passing / pass) it on.
choices: "I will not start a relationship." What is the main meaning?
She is making a clear decision.
"You do not need to reply." What does this mean?
What does Emma say about forgiveness?
She asks Leo to forgive her now.
She is not asking for forgiveness.
Before Claire passes on the letter, what should she do first?
Check if Leo wants to receive it.
Share it with the whole team.

situation: You are Claire. Your tutor is Emma. Read Leo’s reply and Claire’s notes. Explain what Leo agreed to and what is still not decided.
あなたはクレア役、講師はエマ役です。レオの返事とクレアのメモを読み、同意したことと、まだ決まっていないことを説明しましょう。
task: Confirm permission to pass on the letter, the meeting time and place, and the limit of Leo’s agreement. Correct Emma gently if she thinks meeting means getting back together.
手紙を渡す許可、会う日時と場所、同意の範囲を確認します。会う＝復縁だとエマが思ったら、やさしく訂正しましょう。
mission.text:
Leo to Claire
Yes, you can give me Emma’s letter. I will read it when I am ready. Please do not ask me to reply immediately.

Later message, after reading
I can meet Emma at the cafe on Saturday at four. I want to explain my decision myself. Agreeing to meet does not mean we are getting back together.

Claire’s notes
Pass on the letter with permission. Confirm Saturday at four, cafe. Do not promise forgiveness or announce Leo’s decision for him. Let him speak directly.
mission.title: Letter Delivery - Leo’s Actual Reply
lines: Claire, did Leo give permission for you to give him my letter?
Did he promise to reply right away?
When and where did he agree to meet me?
Does agreeing to meet mean we are getting back together?
Should you tell me his decision now, or should I hear it from him?
What should you be careful not to promise for Leo?
mission.evidence: Tutor evidence check: Leo says Claire can give him the letter; he will read it when ready; he asks not to be pushed to reply immediately; he can meet Saturday at four at the cafe; meeting does not mean they will get back together; Leo wants to explain his decision himself. Claire’s notes say: confirm details, do not promise forgiveness, and do not announce Leo’s decision for him.

topics: What words show a firm decision?
How are feelings different from intentions?
What question can stop a wrong assumption?
What action should an apology name?
How can you say a reply is not needed?
What permission should you check first?
How can you keep the exact meaning?
What should you not promise for someone else?
trivia: "Forgive" and "forget" are different. Forgiving does not mean you lose the memory. Also, accepting an apology does not always mean continuing a relationship.
forgive と forget は別です。許すことは、記憶が消えることではありません。また、謝罪を受け入れても、交際の継続に必ずしも同意するとは限りません。
triviaQuestion: Does accepting an apology automatically mean agreeing to continue a relationship?
episode.closing: Claire gives Leo the letter after he agrees. He reads it and agrees to meet Emma at a cafe on Saturday at four to explain his decision himself.
